title: 「The instant …」表示「一……就……」

omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.

formula: The instant + subject + verb, + main clause

formulas.formula: The instant + subject + verb, + main clause
Main clause + the instant + subject + verb

example: The instant I saw the message, I knew something was wrong.
exampleZh: 我一看到那則訊息，就知道出事了。

meaning.zh: 本課練習目標句型：The instant + subject + verb, + main clause。

rules.zh: “The instant” 表示事情立即發生 The instant 的意思接近 as soon as 或 the moment，表示第二件事在第一件事發生時立即出 現。 （門一打開，狗便立即跑了出去。） 它不只是表示兩件事在相近時間發生，而是強調兩者之間幾乎沒有時間間隔。
rules.en: “The instant” shows that something happens immediately. It is close in meaning to as soon as or the moment and shows that the second event occurs as soon as the first one happens: The instant the door opened, the dog ran outside. It emphasises that there is almost no interval between the two events, not merely that they occur around the same time.
examples: The instant the door opened, the dog ran outside.

rules.zh: “The instant” 後面必須接完整子句 “The instant” 後面需要有主語和動詞。
rules.en: Follow “the instant” with a complete clause containing a subject and verb. Correct: The instant I arrived, she called me. Incorrect: The instant my arrival, she called me.
examples: Correct: The instant I arrived, she called me.
Incorrect: The instant my arrival, she called me.

rules.zh: 談及將來時，“the instant” 子句通常使用現在式 在時間子句中，即使意思指向將來，通常也不使用 will。
rules.en: For future meaning, normally use the present tense in the “the instant” time clause rather than will. Correct: I will call you the instant I arrive. Incorrect: I will call you the instant I will arrive.
examples: Correct: I will call you the instant I arrive.
Incorrect: I will call you the instant I will arrive.

rules.zh: 注意逗號位置 當 The instant … 放在句首時，時間子句後通常加逗號。 當它放在主句後面時，通常不用逗號。
rules.en: Pay attention to comma placement. When the “The instant ...” clause comes first, normally put a comma after it: The instant the bell rang, the students left. When it follows the main clause, a comma is normally unnecessary: The students left the instant the bell rang.
examples: The instant the bell rang, the students left.
The students left the instant the bell rang.

rules.zh: 本練習不使用 “that” 在一般英語中，偶爾可以看到 the instant that …，但本練習統一使用較簡潔的：
rules.en: Do not use that in this exercise. Although the instant that ... is occasionally seen in general English, use the more concise the instant + subject + verb here.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能清楚表示一件事在另一件事發生時立即出現，不會令人誤以為兩件事之間相隔了一 段時間。 （我看到訊息時，打電話給她。） （我一看到訊息，便立即打電話給她。） 第二句更清楚地表示「看到訊息後立即致電」。
benefits.en: It makes the timing extremely clear. This structure shows that one event happened immediately when another occurred, so the reader will not assume there was a gap between them. Compare: When I saw the message, I called her. The instant I saw the message, I called her. The second sentence states more clearly that the call was immediate.

benefits.zh: 你可以把兩個緊接發生的動作自然地連成一句，不需要寫成兩個零碎的短句。
benefits.en: It connects two actions naturally You can join two closely connected actions in one complete sentence instead of writing two separate sentences. The alarm rang. Noah woke up immediately. → The instant the alarm rang, Noah woke up.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能把讀者的注意力帶到事情發生的那一刻，令故事、經歷或事件描述更加生動。
benefits.en: It makes stories more vivid The structure draws attention to the exact moment when something changed or happened.

benefits.zh: 你可以用這個句型說明某件事發生後應立即採取甚麼行動，因此特別適合指示、安排、警告及未 來計劃。 （你一到達便立即致電給我。）
benefits.en: It is useful for instructions and future plans You can use it to tell someone what to do immediately after something happens. Call me the instant you arrive.

benefits.zh: 除了反覆使用 as soon as，你亦可以使用 the instant，令說話和寫作的句式更多變。
benefits.en: It gives you an alternative to “as soon as” Instead of repeatedly using as soon as, you can use the instant to create more sentence variety.
